content.title: Under Armour looking into data breach affecting customers' email addresses
content.summary: Clothing retailer Under Armour is investigating a recent data breach that purloined customers' email addresses and other personal information, but so far there are no signs the hackers stole any passwords or financial information.  Have I Been Pwned CEO Troy Hunt said that he agrees with Under Armour's assertion, based on the information that has emerged so far.
